item.title: Court blocks White House ballroom work again, setting up Supreme Court review
item.description: A federal appeals court ruled that above-ground construction requires congressional approval, backing historic preservation advocates.

item.title: Monty Roberts, horse trainer who used trust, dies at 91
item.description: The renowned horseman rejected traditional breaking methods and developed a gentler approach based on equine communication.

item.title: Blanche's confirmation path clears after key Republican backs him
item.description: Senator Bill Cassidy of Louisiana announced support for Todd Blanche's attorney general nomination, easing his path to confirmation.

item.title: Colombia's new president vows to remake the country and challenge rebel groups
item.description: A new political era for Colombia: a hard-right president promises order, growth and confrontation.
